name: Mine Entrance
subtitle: The first chamber of the old mine.

props.label: Mine Exterior
props.note: This passage in the lower middle part of the room leads to Abandoned Mine. Walk into the marked threshold to take that route.

props.label: Deeper Inside
props.note: This passage in the upper middle part of the room leads to Mine Interior. Walk into the marked threshold to take that route.

description: The first mine chamber follows a curving railway beneath thick timber supports. Lanterns hang from the posts and crossbeams, lighting the orange-brown rock walls and the rough floor between the rails. A mine cart full of stones sits on the left, near barrels, buckets and a shovel. More barrels and scattered tools line the right wall. The track curves from the lower foreground into a darker passage near the upper-right side, so the rail gives a clear visual route through the chamber. Beyond the pools of lamplight, the rock and timber recede into deeper shadow.

landmarks.label: Curving entrance rails
landmarks.description: The railway bends through the chamber from the lower foreground towards the upper passage.

landmarks.label: Loaded mine cart
landmarks.description: A cart filled with stones stands beside the rails on the left.

landmarks.label: Hanging mine lanterns
landmarks.description: Oil lanterns hang from the heavy timber posts and roof supports.

landmarks.label: Eastern barrels and tools
landmarks.description: Barrels, loose rocks and mining tools stand against the right-hand rock wall.

landmarks.label: Dark onward tunnel
landmarks.description: The track runs towards a darker opening beneath the upper timbers.
